cap: Tree-lined entrance to the Brighton townhome complex at 13819 232 Street
Front entry with a carpeted staircase up to the main floor
Main floor with laminate floors, a kitchen island with sink and the dining area by the patio door
Dining area looking through the kitchen to the living room and balcony door
Living room with an electric fireplace in a hexagon-tile surround, beside the stairs
Bathroom with a wood vanity and a tub with sliding glass doors
Tandem garage with wall shelving and room for a home gym at the back
Sunny deck with patio seating backing onto a stand of trees
Fenced back yard with a lawn and a patio off the sliding door
